CORAM:
 JUSTICE SASHIKANTA MISHRA ORDER_ 16.04.2024 Order No. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

5.
2. Learned State Counsel informs that notice on the informant has been served on 07.04.2024.

There is however, no appearance for which the bail application is taken up for hearing.
3.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Addl. Standing Counsel for the State.

4. The petitioner is in custody since 08.07.2023 in connection with Ranapur P.S. Case No. 49 of 2023 corresponding to Spl. G.R. Case No. 68 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned Special Judge ( P O C S O ) , N a y a g a r h f o r t h e a l l e g e d c o m m i s s i o n o f o f f e n c e u n d e r S e c t i o n s 363/366/376(2)(n)/506/341/342/294/323/34 of IPC and under Section 6 of POCSO Act.
5. It is alleged that the petitioner kidnapped the victim, who was a minor girl at the relevant time and took her to Puri where he forcibly committed sexual intercourse with her.
The victim became pregnant as a result.
She was rescued after about a month.
However, in the meantime, she is said to have married the deceased.
Some documents relating to the purported marriage of the petitioner and the victim in a temple have been enclosed to the bail application.
Be that as it may, the victim has already been examined and the petitioner has spent more than six months in custody.

sentences.text: 1 6. Under such circumstances, I am inclined to allow the prayer for bail.

Let the petitioner be released on bail on such terms and conditions as the court in seisin over the matter may deem fit and proper to impose including the condition that he shall personally appear before the trial court on each date of posting of the case without fail.
7. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
8. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
(Sashikanta Mishra) Judge B.C. Tudu Signed by: BHIGAL CHANDRA TUDU
